thread:
Maya (PM): quick sync — customer wants an explicit install handoff doc + pricing delta for on-prem agent install vs hosted model. they asked for guaranteed ip blocks, offline installer, and a 4hr rollback SLA.
Sam (Eng): are we pricing installer hours separately or bundled into Dedicated commit?
Maya (PM): they'll likely want a one-time professional services line + an ongoing support SLA. need numbers to show next week.
Leo (NetOps): for ip blocks — we can support customer-provided CIDR ranges but we need a clear mapping for tenant isolation. also inbound peering requires BGP setup doc.
Olivia (SRE): ops note: 4hr rollback SLA is tight if they also want DB migrations during upgrade. suggest 8hr window with fast-path rollback for control-plane only.
Sam (Eng): technically we can do control-plane rollback in ~30m if KV sync is paused, but stateful workloads extend that. we should enumerate which subsystems are hot vs cold.
Maya (PM): action: sam to draft upgrade matrix (control-plane, data-plane, optional migrations) + rollback times. leo to draft IP/CIDR and peering checklist. olivia to propose guaranteed telemetry retention and incident routing for onprem.
Leo (NetOps): noted. for peering doc I'll include BGP sample config, flow logs opt-in, and port list. also need to confirm whether their firewall team allows outbound gRPC to our control plane.
Sam (Eng): rough numbers: on-prem installer + validation run = 12-20 eng-hours depending on environment; we should price at a flat PS day rate with a discounted block for >3 installs.
Maya (PM): good. can you draft two scope options: 'self-service install' + 'white-glove install' with clear SLAs and delivery timelines?
Sam (Eng): yes. self-service = docs + automated preflight + 8hr email support. white-glove = 2 on-site/virtual days + 4hr response SLA + weekend rollback window.
Olivia (SRE): add a canary policy for 5% traffic for first 24h, auto-fallback to hosted when latency > threshold. that helps reduce blast radius.
Maya (PM): customer insisted on 'no data egress' clause — which means agent must keep embeddings and logs local unless explicit export. what's the ops lift?
Leo (NetOps): KMS/HSM integration is doable, we support bring-your-own-keys. but we need to document key rotation impacts during upgrades. also telemetry sampling needs to be configurable.
Sam (Eng): code snippet for preflight we can include in docs:
```
# run on node
curl -fsS https://installer.redwood.ai/preflight.sh | bash -s -- --check-cidr 10.0.0.0/16
```
Maya (PM): perfect. add that to draft.
deploy-bot: build 0.17.3/install-docs-preview passed in CI (link: https://ci.redwood.ai/2387) :white_check_mark:
Olivia (SRE): regarding SLA math — if we promise 4hr rollback, our on-call staffing cost increases significantly. prefer to offer 4hr for critical patches only. also need e2e test harness for airgap installs.
Maya (PM): ok propose tiered SLAs in the proposal: Bronze (standard rollback 24h), Silver (8h rollback, limited patches), Gold (4h rollback, critical-only). include PS estimates per tier.
Sam (Eng): will put eng-hours per tier and a checklist of preconditions (free disk, outbound control-plane access, agreed CIDRs, time window).
Leo (NetOps): one more ask from customer — IP preservation during tenant migration. that's essentially static NAT mapping work; we can support but it's a separate project. flag as add-on.
Maya (PM): flag recorded. NetOps Oncall, any operational concerns we missed?
NetOps Oncall: please ensure we provide sample iptables/nft rules, MTU guidance, and an egress whitelist. also note that some cloud providers need route propagation steps.
Olivia (SRE): once docs draft exists, we should run a lab install this week and capture failures for the FAQ. can volunteer to run it Wed.
Maya (PM): timeline: drafts due Tue COB, internal lab install Wed, customer review Fri. Sam/Leo/Olivia - ack?
Sam (Eng): ack.
Leo (NetOps): ack.
Olivia (SRE): ack.
Maya (PM): I'll also prepare a pricing spreadsheet with PS day rates, tiered SLA uplift %, and a sample contract clause for 'no data egress'. want to avoid legal surprises.
Sam (Eng): toss in an appendix with the preflight checklist, rollback playbook steps, and the minimal service mesh footprint.
Maya (PM): thanks all — will follow up with links to drafts. :calendar:
